text_en: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
text_cn: 保禄和息耳瓦诺及弟茂德，致书给在天主我们的父及主耶稣基督内的得撒洛尼人的教会。

text_en: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 愿恩宠与平安，由天主父和主耶稣基督赐与你们！

text_en: We must always give thanks to God for you, brothers and sisters, as is right, because your faith is growing abundantly, and the love of every one of you for one another is increasing.
text_cn: 弟兄们，我们常该为你们感谢天主，这真是相称的，因为你们的信德大有进步，你们众人之间彼此的爱德更为增进，

text_en: Therefore we ourselves boast of you among the churches of God for your steadfastness and faith during all your persecutions and the afflictions that you are enduring.
text_cn: 以致我们可在天主的各教会中，为你们夸口，因为你们在所受的一切迫害和磨难中，仍保持了坚忍和信德。

text_en: This is evidence of the righteous judgment of God, and is intended to make you worthy of the kingdom of God, for which you are also suffering.
text_cn: 这正是天主公义审判的明证，好使你们堪得天主的国，你们也正是为了这国才受了苦难。

text_en: For it is indeed just of God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
text_cn: 既然天主是公义的，必要以苦难报复难为你们的人，

text_en: and to give relief to the afflicted as well as to us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels
text_cn: 却赏你们受难为的人，同我们一起安宁；主耶稣由天上偕同他大能的天使显现时，

text_en: in flaming fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and on those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
text_cn: 要在火焰中报复那些不认识天主，和不听从我们的主耶稣福音的人。

text_en: These will suffer the punishment of eternal destruction, separated from the presence of the Lord and from the glory of his might,
text_cn: 这些人要受永远丧亡之罚，远离主的面，远离他威能的光荣。

text_en: when he comes to be glorified by his saints and to be marveled at on that day among all who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.
text_cn: 当他在那一日降来的时候，要在他的圣徒身上受光荣，在一切信众身上受赞美。你们也在其中，因为你们确信了我们的证言。

text_en: To this end we always pray for you, asking that our God will make you worthy of his call and will fulfill by his power every good resolve and work of faith,
text_cn: 为此，我们也为你们祈祷，求我们的天主使你们相称他的召叫；求他以德能，成全你们各种乐意向善的心，和信德的行为，

text_en: so that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text_cn: 好使我们的主耶稣基督的名字，在你们内受光荣，你们也在他内，赖我们的天主和主耶稣基督的恩宠受光荣。
